name: Why is it advantageous to have one contractor handle both drywall and finish carpentry?

mainEntity.name: Why is it advantageous to have one contractor handle both drywall and finish carpentry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a contractor who handles both drywall and finish carpentry provides better overall quality control and prevents accountability gaps between phases. When one lead contractor oversees both trades, the framing and drywall crews install backers and ensure square corners specifically tailored for baseboards, crown molding, and door casings. If separate subcontractors handle these steps, trim carpenters often struggle with bowed walls or out-of-square corners, resulting in visible trim gaps and unexpected labor delays during the final punch list.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single contractor coordinates straight framing, flat drywall seams, and exact corners, ensuring door casing, baseboards, and crown molding fit tight without gaps.
